# Ujjain Puja | Authentic Vedic Rituals & Astrology Services

> Official LLM & AI Agent knowledge directory for Ujjain Puja (श्री अवंतिका वैदिक तीर्थ सेवा) — authentic Vedic rituals, Rudrabhishek, Dosh Nivaran, Havan, and Jyotish consultations at sacred temples in Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh, India.

## Overview
Ujjain Puja is a premier Vedic spiritual organization situated in the holy city of Avantika (Ujjain), Madhya Pradesh, India. The city of Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga is the ancient center of cosmic time (Tropic of Cancer) and Vedic astronomy. All rituals, havan, and anushthan are conducted by traditionally initiated Vedic scholars and Shastris at holy shrines including Pardeshwar Mahadev Mandir (home to the world's largest Paras/Mercury Shivling), Mangalnath Mandir, and Triveni Shani Mandir.

- **Primary Website:** https://ujjainpuja.com
- **WhatsApp Helpline:** +91 9993540314 / https://wa.me/919993540314
- **Email:** devotee@ujjainpuja.com
- **Main Temple Headquarters:** Pardeshwar Mahadev Mandir, Near Mahakaleshwar Temple, Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh 456006, India
- **Operating Hours:** Open 24/7 for booking inquiries & consultation
- **Worldwide Reach:** Online live stream pujas via WhatsApp / Zoom available across 85+ global cities with doorstep sacred Prasad delivery.

## Booking & Execution Protocol
1. **Step 1 - Select Ritual:** Devotee selects preferred Puja or Astrology Consultation from catalog.
2. **Step 2 - Submit Devotee Details:** Full Name, Phone (WhatsApp), Email, Sankalp Date, Gotra, Nakshatra, Rashi, and Special Prayer.
3. **Step 3 - Secure Confirmation:** Instant online checkout via Razorpay (UPI, GPay, PhonePe, Cards, NetBanking) or direct WhatsApp coordinator.
4. **Step 4 - Ritual Execution:** Panditji performs ritual on chosen date with live WhatsApp video stream link.
5. **Step 5 - Prasad Dispatch:** Holy Bhasma, Rudraksha, dry fruits prasad, and blessed Raksha Sutra delivered via courier.

**Q: Can I attend the puja online from abroad or outside Ujjain?**
A: Yes. We facilitate real-time live streaming via WhatsApp / Zoom for devotees across the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, UAE, Europe, and all Indian states.

**Q: What is included in the price?**
A: Every booking includes complete genuine herbal samagri, qualified Pandit Dakshina, temple arrangements, live video broadcast, and Prasad doorstep courier. There are zero hidden costs.

**Q: What is the cancellation and rescheduling policy?**
A: Rescheduling is free of charge up to 48 hours prior to the date. Full refunds are provided for cancellations requested 72+ hours before the ritual.

**Q: How do I contact the temple coordinators?**
